pairs.registryProposal: Size budgets deliberately disarm the gate when the row is absent and arm it only when the row is unreadable. The ceiling rule collapses both to closed; the standard needs a sentence if an unconfigured gate may stay opt-in while only an unreadable row must fail closed.
